headline: Nidec Files March Accounts With Auditor Disclaimer
deck: The motor maker submitted its year-to-March-2026 securities report to the Kanto Finance Bureau; the auditor issued no opinion, and the net loss was 564 billion yen after EV-drive impairments.
body: Nidec on 30 September filed its securities report for the year to March 2026 with the Kanto Finance Bureau, Nikkei reported. [E1] The auditor's opinion, the same account said, was a disclaimer of opinion, 意見不表明. [E2]
For that fiscal year the company reported a net loss of 564 billion yen ($3.6 billion), after booking massive impairment losses mainly related to its struggling electric vehicle drive business. [E3]
